kv2.sub: Every write creates a new version. Delete is reversible, destroy is not. Values are masked until you reveal them.

stats.hintMount: Whole secret/ mount, not only this level
stats.hintDeleted: Soft-deleted plus destroyed versions across the mount

jump.label: Jump to a prefix
jump.placeholder: Jump to a prefix, e.g. apps/web

forbidden.title: No access to this path
forbidden.text2: capability on this prefix. Ask a policy owner to grant it.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.text: holds no secrets. Write the first one.

value.viewingText: This is not the current version (v{{current}}).
value.destroyedText: Data of v{{version}} was destroyed permanently and cannot be restored.
value.deletedText: v{{version}} is soft-deleted. The data is kept and can be restored.
value.rawNote: Raw JSON as stored. Values are shown in full.
value.autoHiddenText: Revealed values were hidden again after 30 seconds.

ver.evictedText: max_versions is {{max}}: versions {{first}} to {{last}} were dropped on write and cannot be restored.

diff.noneText: At least two readable versions are needed.
diff.hiddenNote: Values are masked. Turn on "Show values" to see them.

meta.hint: max_versions: how many versions are kept. 0 means unlimited. New secrets start with the mount default. Older versions are dropped on the next write. cas_required: every write must carry the cas parameter.
meta.cmHint: Plain strings, not secret values. Key up to {{keys}} bytes, value up to {{value}} bytes, at most {{pairs}} pairs.
meta.cmTooLong: A key is longer than {{key}} bytes or a value is longer than {{value}} bytes.

confirm.softText: v{{version}} will be marked as deleted. You can restore it later.
confirm.destroyText: v{{version}} will be removed permanently. This cannot be undone. Type {{version}} to confirm.

bulk.text_one: The current version of the selected secret will be soft-deleted. It can be restored.
bulk.text_other: The current versions of the selected secrets will be soft-deleted. They can be restored.

write.title: Write secret
write.name: Name
write.nameHint: Letters, digits and . _ - ; use / for subfolders.
write.nameFormat: Only letters, digits and . _ - / are allowed
write.nameFolder: {{path}}/ is a folder, pick another name
write.textPlaceholder: Any text. JSON objects are split into keys.
write.textHint: Stored as one string. Masked until you reveal it.
write.casOptional: Write only if the current version matches.
write.casMissing: New secret: use 0 to forbid overwriting.
write.cas0: only if the secret does not exist
write.casN: only if the current version is N
write.conflictText: You gave version {{given}}, but the secret is now at v{{actual}}. Someone wrote to it in the meantime.
write.toast409Text: The secret changed. Check the CAS value.
write.casRequiredErr: This secret requires check-and-set: enter the current version, or 0 for a new one.
